scenario.title: A charger that vanishes mid-session opens the contactor, and closing it again needs no reset
scenario.description: Bring a charge session up with the vehicle commanded down, so a closed contactor can only mean charging. Take the charger off the bus: one missed status frame must not be a fault, but 300 ms without power must raise CHARGE_LOST and open the contactor. Give the power back, and the pack must recover by itself — saying so on its console, closing the contactor, and never restating the fault — with no reset anywhere in the scenario.
